scope: Common Lab 10 + Baransu Lab 4 + Estimate Lab 1; isolated revision, not prior overnight experiment

time.coverage: Snapshot interval, not exact end-to-end billing or all final handoff work

limits: Counter delta for the explicitly timestamped main-thread snapshots; baseline precedes first tool observation.
Input includes repeated context and cached input; do not add cached input again.
Reasoning output is reported separately as a component; do not add it again to total.
No verified per-child attribution or guarantee of aggregation semantics. Do not sum this with other native-agent counters.
Excludes recorded usage after the cutoff and is not the final turn bill.

cost.reason: No invoice or per-turn charge available; no API-equivalent price substituted.

quality.supported: Behavior controls and regressions verified to their stated scope; fresh scenario responses select intended boundaries.
quality.not_supported: No numerical quality score, statistically significant A/B win, human comprehension proof, 24-hour reliability claim, or cross-model ranking.

friction.item: Fresh campaign calibration and bounded repair handback
friction.tradeoff: Extra context and decision latency for high-coupling work; net benefit not long-run measured.
Small document cost; reuse one record and do not impose it on trivial changes.

friction.item: CLI source/brief alias and malformed top-level rejection inconsistency
Quick validator rejects transfer-generated compatibility metadata
friction.resolution: Keep raw failures; verify field against Agent Skills spec and remaining content with unchanged validator on retained projection.

presentation.method: Outcome first, task-scale table, per-skill changes and friction, then evidence and limits
